first_lines: Two CSV files accompany the LARK multi-view video dataset. They contain the per-measurement registration-error results computed from the videos: every fiducial, target, and trajectory error, for both LARK tracking pipelines and the gold-standard reference tracker, across all trials, camera configurations, and filtering variants. These are the data underlying Table 1, Table C.1, and Figures 8 to 11 and C.1 of the paper.
